description.value: Noralee Resort is a waterfront resort on Francois Lake, 70km from Burns Lake in BC's Lakes District, offering year-round cabin rentals, RV sites with full or partial hookups, and tent camping on one of BC's purest lakes. The resort is a destination for sport fishing — rainbow trout, kokanee, Dolly Varden, char, and burbot — with annual fishing derbies all summer and boat rentals available on site. An on-site store stocks forgotten supplies, and the remote lakeside setting puts guests amid eagles, osprey, bears, moose, and deer in the Cariboo Chilcotin backcountry.
